netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_SQ1 n1 SQ1_am 0
V_SQ1 SQ1_int 0 PULSE(0 12 0 1e-09 1e-09 4.99e-07 1e-06)
R_SQ1_in SQ1_am SQ1_int 0.1
vam_R1 n1 R1_am 0
R_R1 R1_am n2 100
vam_R2 n3 R2_am 0
R_R2 R2_am 0 10000
vam_M1 n2 M1_am 0
vam_M1_p0 n3 M1_p0 0
vam_M1_p2 0 M1_p2 0
M_M1 M1_am M1_p0 M1_p2 M1_p2 2N7000
C_M1_cgs M1_p0 M1_p2 1.6e-11
C_M1_cgd M1_p0 M1_am 4e-12
C_M1_ds M1_am M1_p2 8p
.model 2N7000 NMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=2.1 KP=0.1 LAMBDA=0.01 RD=1 RS=1 CGSO=0 CGDO=0)   # the real pin capacitances (Ciss/Crss) are added as capacitors in the netlist
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 5e-09 5e-06 0 5e-09
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) v(n3) i(vam_sq1) i(vam_r1) i(vam_r2) i(vam_m1) i(vam_m1_p0) i(vam_m1_p2)
quit
.endc
.end
